evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton declares a recurring rehearsal mandate from position authority, then frames the consequence as a categorical loss — insistence plus legitimate standing in one commissive act.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityYouDoNotHave
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted by declaring that an unexercised capability is no capability at all?
